_comment: Identity and image assets of the A5 Reference PCB Assembly. Hand-written;
assemble.py copies it into data/a5.js. Page numbers are PDF pages of
732A-manual.pdf with the printed manual page after them. The reference
circuit inside the oven is not field-repairable (§4-53); the board is
documented here so its parts can be found and its test points named.
